project.name: osgi/runtime/boot/boot-logging
project.description: FelixJulLogger: reroutes Felix's OWN internal logger onto the JDK java.util.logging bus (via felix.log.logger), the host half of the boot's INVERTED logging convergence. Host logs ride JUL — host slf4j binds to slf4j-jdk14, native emitters (io.grpc, the JDK) already speak JUL, and this carries Felix's trace onto it too — and pax-logging-api's JdkHandler drains that bus into pax-logging-logback, the single sink. Pax-free by design (no org.slf4j provider here), so depending on boot-logging never drags a second provider onto a test classpath (the scar that broke jGiven in-container resolution). A plain jar, touched JVM-side, never installed as a bundle.
